title: Evaluation at the input layer
statement: Let $F$ be a layered circuit with input type $\mathrm{inp}$ and alphabet $\alpha$. For a node $u$ at layer $0$ and an input assignment $xs:\mathrm{inp}\to\alpha$, the value of $u$ is the value assigned by $xs$ to the input corresponding to $u$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a layered circuit with the stated input type and alphabet
